message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for the case.

Facts: Defendant Lu stored various drugs in his rented house. The police seized multiple types: heroin, MDMA, ketamine, methamphetamine, etc. The prosecution says illegal possession of heroin, methamphetamine over 50 grams. So the crime is illegal possession of drugs (非法持有毒品). In the correction lessons, there is label 【非法持有毒品】 (not “持有毒品” maybe). The examples: earlier they had "非法持有毒品" for case with heroin etc. So we should label as "非法持有毒品". No other crimes like trafficking, manufacturing, etc. He just possessed. So single label.

Thus output JSON with reasoning and final answer.
